question: The writer of the novel 'Kitne Pakistan' based on the harsh realities of Partition is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamleshwar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamleshwar** was a renowned **Indian author, screenwriter, and journalist**.
 
• He wrote the novel **'Kitne Pakistan'**, which is based on the harsh realities of the **Partition of India**.
 
• The novel is known for its **unique narrative style** and **critical perspective** on the historical events surrounding the Partition.
 
• Kamleshwar's work in literature often reflected his **progressive views** and his commitment to addressing **social issues**.
 
• 'Kitne Pakistan' is considered one of his most significant contributions to **Hindi literature**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Phanishwar Nath Renu**__

 __
 
• **Phanishwar Nath Renu** was an influential **Indian writer** known for his work in **Hindi literature**.
 
• He is best known for his novel **'Maila Anchal'**, which is a classic in Hindi literature.
 
• Renu's works often depict the **rural life** and **social issues** in India.
 
 
 
• **Kashinath Singh**__
 __
 
• **Kashinath Singh** is an esteemed **Hindi writer** known for his novels and short stories.
 
• He is famous for his book **'Kashi Ka Assi'**, which portrays the cultural and social life of Varanasi.
 
• His writings are known for their **social commentary** and **insightful narratives**.
 
 
 
• **Munshi Premchand**__
 
 
• **Munshi Premchand** is one of the most celebrated **Hindi-Urdu writers** in India.
 
• He is renowned for his novels such as **'Godan'** and **'Nirmala'**, which explore **social and economic issues**.
 
• Premchand's works are known for their **realistic portrayal** of the life of the common man.
